preventing a broad subscription from becoming an implicit interaction-delivery channel.

SessionRequestResult.description: Typed result returned by the canonical Session aggregate mutation endpoint.

SessionSubscribeResult.description: The aggregate Session port returned to product hosts.

SessionThread.description: A Session-owned reference to one Thread, its origin, and membership lifecycle.

SessionThreadProjection.description: A child Thread snapshot and its committed gap carried by the Session subscription.

history.description: Present whenever the request selected bounded history.

SessionThreadStatus.description: Session-owned lifecycle for one Thread membership.

SkillId.description: Source-qualified stable identity for one Skill.

SkillName.description: Agent Skills-compatible name, unique within one Skill source.

SkillRef.description: Catalog-owned Skill selection that never exposes a host filesystem path.

SkillResourceOpenParams.description:
Opens one inert package resource from an exact Skill revision.

`path` remains package-relative. The server revalidates both the Skill digest and the rooted
resource path before publishing bytes into the connection-owned Resource store.

SkillSourceAddParams.description: Adds a user-owned, runtime-free Skill source declaration.

SkillSourceConfigDto.description: Runtime-free declaration for one user-owned Skill source.

SkillSourceEnablementDto.description: Desired enablement for one configured user Skill source.

SkillSourceId.description: Stable identity for one configured, built-in, Workspace, or Plugin Skill source.

SkillSourceRemoveParams.description: Removes one user-owned Skill source declaration.

SkillSourceSetEnablementParams.description: Changes desired enablement for one configured user Skill source.

SkillVersionSelector.description: Selects whether a new activation follows the current catalog or requires exact bytes.

SlashCommandArgumentModeDto.description: Whether a server-advertised slash command accepts inline composer arguments.

SlashCommandDefinition.description:
One server-advertised command in the immutable initialization snapshot.

Clients may merge these commands with local presentation commands. A submitted dynamic command
remains ordinary ordered Turn input; the definition only makes its slash syntax discoverable
and declares whether inline arguments are accepted.

StreamCursor.description: Ephemeral ordering cursor for updates that are not part of durable aggregate history.

StreamInstanceId.description:
Stable identity for one transient stream-emitter incarnation.

A new value is created whenever the emitter restarts. Its sequence is meaningful only within
that instance, so consumers must discard a previous cursor when this value changes.

SymbolIndexSearchHitDto.description: One revision-verified local symbol match in editor-native UTF-16 coordinates.

matchedIndices.description: Zero-based UTF-16 offsets into `name` suitable for Renderer highlighting.

SymbolIndexSearchParams.description: Performs one bounded local fuzzy lookup against workspace declarations.

SymbolIndexSearchResult.description: Bounded verified matches paired with the symbol generation that served them.

discardedStaleHitCount.description: Matches discarded because their exact source revision could no longer be materialized.

SymbolIndexStateDto.description: Lifecycle state of the workspace-side declaration projection.

SymbolIndexStatusResult.description: Published counters for the current or most recent usable symbol generation.

SymbolKindDto.description: Language-neutral category of a syntactically declared symbol.

SyntaxAnalyzeParams.description: Immutable document snapshot submitted for bounded syntax analysis.

SyntaxAnalyzeResult.description: Parser-derived facts for exactly one submitted editor revision.

SyntaxDiagnosticDto.description: One parser diagnostic projected for editor presentation.

SyntaxLanguageDto.description: Grammar supported by the authoritative syntax-analysis service.

SyntaxPositionDto.description: One zero-based UTF-16 position, matching the editor text-model coordinate system.

SyntaxRangeDto.description: One ordered, end-exclusive UTF-16 source range.

SyntaxSelectionRangeDto.description: One parser-derived range used for structural selection expansion.

SyntaxSelectionRangesParams.description: Exact document and editor selections submitted for bounded structural-scope lookup.

SyntaxSelectionRangesResult.description: Deduplicated parser scopes enclosing the submitted selections for one exact revision.

SyntaxSymbolDto.description: One parser-derived declaration in a document snapshot.

SyntaxSymbolKindDto.description: Language-neutral kind for one syntactically declared document symbol.

SyntaxTokenKindDto.description: Stable highlighting category projected from the Rust syntax engine.

TerminalAttachParams.description: Reclaims one reconnectable terminal after its previous connection closed.

TerminalAttachResult.description: Confirms attachment and rotates the bearer token for the next disconnect.

TerminalCloseParams.description: Terminates and releases one terminal attached to the calling connection.

TerminalCommandStatus.description: Renderer-independent lifecycle state for one shell command.

TerminalCommandStatusEvent.description: One ordered command lifecycle transition associated with PTY output.

TerminalCreateParams.description: Starts one interactive terminal at the server's trusted workspace root.

TerminalCreateResult.description: Identity allocated for one interactive terminal.

TerminalLifecycle.description: Selects whether a terminal dies with its creating connection or may be reattached briefly.

TerminalOutputChunk.description: One ordered raw PTY output chunk encoded for JSON transport.

TerminalProfile.description: One server-owned shell profile available to interactive terminal clients.

TerminalProfileListResult.description: Trusted terminal profiles discovered by the local App Server composition.

TerminalProfileSelection.description: Selects either the server default or one previously listed trusted profile.

TerminalReadParams.description: Reads output after the last sequence observed by this client.

TerminalReadResult.description: Bounded output and process state for one interactive terminal.

TerminalReconnectLease.description: One short-lived bearer lease used to reattach a detached terminal.

TerminalWriteParams.description: Writes one bounded UTF-8 input batch to an interactive terminal.

Thread.description: Canonical readable state for one independently ordered Agent execution branch.

ThreadEvent.description:
A durable fact in one Thread's authoritative event stream.

This enum deliberately excludes token deltas, delivery notifications, and client requests so
persistence adapters cannot accidentally append transient runtime messages.

oneOf.description:
Legacy read-compatibility fact from the removed external full-Turn backend integration.
Current product code does not append this event.

Legacy read-compatibility fact from the removed external full-Turn backend integration.
Current product code does not append this event.

ThreadGoal.description: The durable Thread-scoped task Goal and its cumulative token usage.

ThreadGoalStatus.description: Lifecycle state for the one durable Goal owned by a Thread.

ThreadHistoryBoundary.description: Describes whether a bounded Thread snapshot has older durable Turns available.

ThreadId.description: Stable identity for one independently ordered Agent execution branch.

ThreadItem.description: A normalized, provider-independent item produced or consumed during one Thread turn.

ThreadOrigin.description: How a Thread entered a product Session.

ThreadSequenceRange.description: Inclusive durable child Thread sequence range supporting a delegation result.

ThreadSnapshotHistory.description: Selects how much durable Turn history is included in a Thread snapshot.

oneOf.description:
Selects a bounded page of Turns older than the supplied durable Turn identity.

The returned Thread sequence still describes the aggregate at read time. It does not mean
that the older page contains or confirms every Turn represented by that sequence.

ThreadTranscriptChange.description: Mechanical list mutation applied by transcript consumers before rendering.

ThreadTranscriptEntry.description: One complete, render-neutral entry in a Thread transcript.

ThreadTranscriptSnapshot.description: Initial or resynchronized transcript derived from one canonical Thread snapshot.

ThreadTranscriptUpdateEnvelope.description: One backend-assembled transcript update delivered through App Server.

ThreadUpdate.description:
Consumer-facing update for one Thread.

`Committed` carries a durable fact. The remaining variants are low-latency projections and
may be dropped; a later committed Item snapshot remains authoritative.

ToolCallBinding.description:
Durable binding between one Tool Call and the exact definition/source generation it selected.

Runtime keys are intentionally absent. Recovery must compare this value with an available
immutable source snapshot and fail closed when the exact binding can no longer be restored.

ToolCallCaller.description: Identifies how the model-visible Tool Call reached the ordinary tool scheduler.

ToolCallId.description: Stable identity for one model-requested tool call and its eventual result.

ToolExecutionAuthority.description: Durable authority selected before a Tool Call crosses its side-effect boundary.

ToolMode.description:
Selects how a model may use the ordinary Tool catalog for one Turn.

`Direct` is the compatibility default. `CodeMode` keeps the ordinary direct surface and adds
the Code Mode entry points. `CodeModeOnly` exposes only those entry points while the projected
ordinary tools remain callable from JavaScript.

ToolName.description: Validated provider-independent name used to register and invoke a tool.

ToolProfileSnapshot.description: Immutable model-visible tool surface selected for one Turn.

ToolReplaySafety.description: Whether Core may automatically execute the same exact Tool Call after sandbox review.

ToolSearchConfigDto.description: Durable Tool Search preference plus the active App Server runtime status.

ToolSearchConfigureParams.description: Selects lexical Tool Search or enables one exact embedding model after a readiness probe.

ToolSearchEmbeddingStatusDto.description: Runtime readiness of the optional Tool Search embedding path.

ToolSearchModeDto.description: User-selected retrieval mode for deferred Agent tools.

ToolSourceProvenance.description:
One stable, secret-free hop in the source chain of a durable Tool Call binding.

Hosts append hops in distribution-to-execution order. Mutable process identities, credentials,
session handles, and filesystem paths must never be stored here.

Turn.description: Canonical readable state for one user-intent-driven Agent execution.

TurnExecutionBinding.description:
Legacy durable binding from a local Thread to an external full-Turn execution runtime.

Zeta no longer creates these bindings. The type remains serializable so existing Thread history
can still be read without discarding its original recovery facts.

executionScope.description:
Opaque authority scope in which the external thread was created.

Adapters must compare this value before resuming the remote thread. It intentionally
excludes filesystem paths and credentials while preventing cross-workspace reuse.

TurnId.description: Stable identity for one user-intent-driven Agent execution within a Thread.

TurnInteraction.description:
One outstanding interaction that pauses a Turn until it is resolved or cancelled.

The request is durable product state. Selecting a connection that receives it is an App
Server delivery concern and deliberately does not appear here.

WorkspaceBinding.description:
Durable Session binding to one canonical Workspace authority.

Product hosts use the root to reopen the Workspace and must recompute the authority ID before
enabling execution. The ID is never a substitute for containment or a current trust decision.

WorkspaceDocumentOverlayCloseParams.description: Releases one editor document from the ephemeral code-intelligence overlay.

WorkspaceDocumentOverlayStatusResult.description: Content-free summary of the current in-memory editor overlay.

WorkspaceDocumentOverlaySynchronizeParam.description: Publishes the latest immutable editor text for one workspace-relative document.

WorkspaceFolderDto.description: One canonical folder accepted into the active Workspace.

WorkspaceFolderSetEntry.description: One folder requested by a product-hosted multi-root Workspace.

WorkspaceFoldersSetParams.description: Atomically replaces the ordered folders hosted by one App Server session.

WorkspaceSearchCancelParams.description: Cancels and releases one connection-owned workspace search.

WorkspaceSearchCaseSensitivity.description: Selects the case-matching behavior used by one workspace search.

WorkspaceSearchMatch.description: One line containing one or more matches in a workspace-relative file.

WorkspaceSearchMatchRange.description: UTF-16 range within one returned preview line.

WorkspaceSearchPatternKind.description: Selects how the workspace search query is interpreted by the backend.

WorkspaceSearchReadParams.description: Reads a bounded result batch after an already observed match cursor.

WorkspaceSearchReadResult.description: Bounded progress snapshot for a running or completed workspace search.

WorkspaceSearchStartParams.description: Starts one bounded, connection-owned workspace content search.

WorkspaceSearchStartResult.description: Identity allocated for one running workspace search.

WorkspaceSwitchParams.description: Replaces the active local Workspace hosted by one App Server.

WorkspaceSwitchResult.description: Confirms the canonical Workspace root accepted by the App Server.

WorkspaceSwitchTrust.description: Authority used to resolve one client-requested Workspace switch.

oneOf.description: Resolves the canonical root against the durable UserConfig authority.
Grants only this App Server runtime a host-configured trust lease.
Persists the explicit choice before activating the canonical root.

WorkspaceTrustEntryDto.description:
One persisted trusted folder projected for the trust-management surface.

`workspace` remains the authoritative identity. `root` is display metadata and may be absent
for decisions written by older clients. Restricted decisions are intentionally omitted from
this management projection; an absent entry is the normal Restricted-mode state.

WorkspaceTrustForgetParams.description: Removes one user trust decision by its opaque Workspace identity.

WorkspaceTrustHostCapability.description:
Declares that this connection is owned by a product host that can collect Workspace trust.

This is an authority boundary for host-only protocol operations. Renderer or extension
connections must not declare it merely because they can display a trust prompt.

WorkspaceTrustId.description:
Opaque, durable lookup key for one canonical Workspace root.

Hosts persist this value instead of the filesystem path itself. It intentionally identifies
the canonical path boundary rather than Workspace-controlled content, so aliases resolve to
the same key and moving the directory requires a new trust decision.

WorkspaceTrustListResult.description: Lists the trusted folders and workspace files in the active profile.

WorkspaceTrustReadParams.description: Reads the durable user decision and effective UserConfig state for one exact canonical Workspace.

setting.description: The durable decision, when one exists. Restricted is represented by omission.

state.description: The effective state used by UserConfig-backed Workspace activation.

WorkspaceTrustSetParams.description:
Updates one user's trusted-root decision without switching the active Workspace.

`trusted` adds an entry. `restricted` is retained for compatibility and removes the entry.

WorkspaceTrustSettingDto.description:
Trust state collected by a product host.

`Restricted` is a transient/runtime choice and is represented durably by removing the trusted
root; it must not create a Restricted entry in the user's allowlist.

WorkspaceTrustStateDto.description: Effective trust state committed by the App Server.
